remediated_vulnerabilities.title: Prompt injection unguarded in default neural chat mode
Plaintext Gemini API key persisted in browser cookie & missing HttpOnly flag on session cookie
Unbounded HTTP Content-Length DoS & missing client_ip forwarding in HTTP server

remaining_findings.title: CSP allows 'unsafe-inline' for single-file HTML/JS UI
remaining_findings.recommendation: Split inline scripts in ui/index.html into hashed/external static JS bundles before public internet deployment.

remaining_findings.title: Local launcher persists .jwt_secret on disk without Windows DPAPI encryption
remaining_findings.recommendation: Use OS secret store / environment variable injection (NOURAI_SECRET_KEY) in production deployments.

remaining_findings.title: Prompt-injection filter is pattern-based and can be bypassed by paraphrased adversarial inputs
remaining_findings.recommendation: Add learned safety classifier + instruction-hierarchy alignment once model scales past Level 2.

remaining_findings.title: Offline audit could not run online CVE database scan (pip-audit)
remaining_findings.recommendation: Run pip-audit in CI against minimal dependency tree (torch 2.15.0+cpu, numpy 2.5.4, jinja2 3.1.6).
